evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: "it might take ten to fifteen minutes. Is this a good time?" — framing is present (time-boxed), but no explicit promise of a dependable quote, and no clear wait for affirmation before moving to probing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: "Aside from the pricing, Carlos, do you have any concern about the moving process?" — asked, but only after the rep has already confirmed name, address, and begun initial discovery. Probing started first with address confirmation.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered "I think I understand the moving process best but I'll ask if something comes up" — no actual concern was raised, so N/A rule applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns were raised by the customer, so no reflection opportunity arose. N/A rule applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep covered property type (1-story, then 2-story), rooms (4 bedrooms), garage (2-car, one car parking space, garage contents including bookshelves, rowing machine), driveway (yes at both locations), access concerns (single step at front door), large appliances (washer/dryer, fridge), furniture (2 couches, 3 beds with frame types), special items (books, light workout equipment). Requested garage photo to finalize. Nearly all seven logistics items covered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: "Normally for a 1600 square feet house, we see fifty to sixty boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?" — asked directly.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No estimate given. Rep stated "I already have the estimate here for the house" but never delivered a number, range, or personalized anchor. Pivoted to requesting garage photo first and said estimate would come via email.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: No pricing given, no fee transparency, no 2.5-hour minimum or increments framing, no trip/overnight fees mentioned.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Call ended with email/photo exchange, no pricing discussion completed.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No promises were delivered, so nothing to close the loop on.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep moved directly to email/follow-up logistics without a final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep ended the call by saying "I'll just wait for your response" to the garage photo, with no ask for the business or booking confirmation.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently, covering property specs, special items, access concerns, and garage contents with good follow-up probing on each category.
coaching_note: This call never reached pricing or a booking ask — it derailed into a photo-collection task loop; always deliver or frame the estimate before pivoting to supplemental requests, and close with an explicit business ask and confirmation of next steps.
